newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks edge into positive territory.
newsitem.headline: French stocks edge into positive territory.

text.p: French stocks edged into positive territory in late trading on Friday after having spent most of the day consolidating recent gains.
* CAC-40 index up 2.91 points, or 0.1 percent, at 2,939.89 at 1220 GMT after coming back from a session low of 2,913.24
* CAC-40 July futures contract up eight at 2,948
* Volume a modest 4.5 billion francs due to closure of U.S. markets for Independence Day holiday
